metaTitle: Custom Jersey Medical Healthcare Items | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom jersey medical healthcare items for your facility. Soft, breathable, and perfect for bulk branding at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Jersey fabric offers a soft, breathable feel that makes it ideal for medical healthcare items like stress balls, lanyards, or badge reels. Unlike vinyl or nylon, jersey provides a comfortable texture for items worn or handled daily. Bulk buyers often choose jersey for employee giveaways or patient comfort products because the material accepts screen printing and embroidery cleanly, keeping your logo crisp through repeated use.
